pressure_gauge: p(x,t)-p(0,0,0,t); network pressure target0 at every gauge time
independent_acceptance: scalar-coordinate Torch AD with fixed validation data; full final parameter/data tensors offbox for independent CPU replay
counterpart_reference: A24 full spatial cubic + dt + grad dt, complete autograd parameter reverse (qualification reference only; not a timed arm here)
arxiv_contribution_state: generic3D training only if actually accepted; original n0/n1 stillpending

arm_roles.c17_compiled: FlashNS-3D candidate, make_fx + torch.compile (default mode) + CUDA Graph
arm_roles.torch_ad_compiled: external baseline, make_fx + torch.compile (default mode) + CUDA Graph
arm_roles.jet_collapsed_compiled: external baseline, make_fx + torch.compile (default mode) + CUDA Graph

external_baseline_scope: Derivative-method baselines on the same PINN objective: nested PyTorch autograd and collapsed Taylor mode (jet). Numerical CFD solvers (the earlier CaNS-GPU/NekRS plan) are a different comparison and are not run here.
initializer: numpy default_rng(seed).normal(size=(out,in))*sqrt(2/(in+out)), zero bias; seeds 642201-642203 regenerate bit-identically to data-v1

development_seed_excluded.reason: observed in H20 r2 (protocol v2) and in a CPU development diagnostic under protocol v3 (C17 accepted at L-BFGS block 195, pressure relative L2 0.03996); never a formal seed

hardware: NVIDIA H100 (64 GB), one exclusive four-GPU node

execution_plan.lane_assignment: formal seeds in protocol order on lanes 0,1,2,3,0,1
execution_plan.arm_order: the six arms rotated cyclically by seed index, so each arm takes each position once
execution_plan.process: one fresh process per case; no retries; nonconvergence and runtime failures retained

paired_statistic: per-seed baseline/C17 setup-plus-optimization ratio for jointly accepted pairs, reported with all outcomes; geometric mean over accepted pairs
timing_caveat: two lanes run concurrently on one node that may host other owners on its remaining GPUs; ratios are within-lane pairs
derived_from: protocol-ext-20261016.json (same data, formal seeds, objective, optimizer, stop checks, qualification and acceptance)
execution_mode: graph arms: unchanged from protocol-ext-20261016 (external.evaluate, one CUDA Graph). compiled arms: external.build_compiled traces the whole loss/gradient with make_fx over a model that aliases the solver parameters, compiles it with torch.compile(fullgraph=True, dynamic=False) and captures it in one CUDA Graph
runtime: Torch 2.12.1+cu130 runtime shared with the 2D studies (read-only), FP64, TF32 disabled; deterministic algorithms requested with warn_only=True for every arm

lanes.seed_to_lane: seeds in protocol order go to lanes 0,1,2,3,0,1
lanes.arm_order: the six permutations of the three arms, one per seed in protocol order; the three arms of a seed run on the same GPU

qualification: unchanged: three small-data (7 points) updates against independent scalar-coordinate AD (eager path) and three full-data in-place updates replayed through the arm itself (compiled and graph-captured for compiled arms) against the A24 reference, within 2e-12 + 2e-11|reference|; CPU preflight of the compiled path before submission

statistics.primary: selected external variant over selected C17 variant: paired geometric mean of setup-plus-optimization time over jointly accepted formal seeds
statistics.secondary: the same ratio for optimization-only time
statistics.supplementary: every arm against c17_graph (replicating protocol-ext-20261016), compile factor per method (graph/compiled per evaluation and per replay), first-of-arm setup per lane

expectations.compile: in the 2D H100 retest, compiling made collapsed-Taylor, ED and torch-AD replays 3.2, 5.0 and 2.3 times faster; similar gains are expected for the external arms and possibly for C17; the compiled collapsed jet may match or beat C17; no numeric prediction

scope_note: The review asked for an external baseline on the 3D C36 objective. C36 has no accepted solve, so this study uses the accepted Ethier--Steinman benchmark instead; the C36 item stays open

warmup.stage: each lane first runs every arm once on development seed 642201 in warm-only mode: setup, capture, the unchanged qualification, then 200 timed replays; no training. Warm-only outputs are not formal solves
warmup.purpose: fills each lane cache before formal solves and measures replay time per variant

selection_rule: for each method, the variant (graph or compiled) with the lower median warm-up replay time over the four lanes, among variants whose warm-up qualification passed, is its selected variant; fixed before any formal solve is read

decision_rule.C17 faster: ratio above 1.03 and at least 5 of the jointly accepted pairs favour C17 (needs at least 5 jointly accepted pairs)
decision_rule.external faster: ratio below 1/1.03 and at least 5 of the jointly accepted pairs favour the external method
decision_rule.no decided difference: otherwise, with at least 5 jointly accepted pairs
decision_rule.applies_to: primary and secondary statistics, separately for torch_ad and jet_collapsed

cache_note: if formal compiled solves still show cold-cache setup (setup well above their warm-up setup), setup-plus-optimization is confounded by cache state and the reading leans on the optimization-only decision
caches: every lane sets TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR, TRITON_CACHE_DIR, XDG_CACHE_HOME, TMPDIR and CUDA_CACHE_PATH under the batch root
deadline: cases start only while at least 30 minutes remain before the driver deadline (allocation end minus 15 minutes); a running case is stopped at that deadline and kept
earlier_result: protocol-ext-20261016 (all arms uncompiled): collapsed jet 1.085 (0.98-1.19), nested AD 1.901 against C17; it stays reported as measured
